```{r}
#| label: setup
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(effectsize)

fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 2) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits)
fmt_p <- function(p) if (p < .001) "< .001" else paste("=", sub("^0", "", fmt_num(p, 3)))
fmt_bounded <- function(x, digits = 2) sub("^(-?)0\\.", "\\1.", fmt_num(x, digits))

crew <- read_csv("astronauts.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: people
# One row per astronaut: first missions, with sex, age and total_missions
people <- crew
```
